name: PARDUS Robin EVO competition build
why_interesting: An exact-model 6.2 kg competition build shows the Robin EVO's lightweight potential, and official product pages provide a factory reference without conflating the builds.
missing: Map the competition post to the official 750 g generation or the newer Robin EVO platform
Current mainland price, current-generation stock BOM and stock state
Manufacturer maximum tire clearance for the exact competition-build generation
Current warranty terms and confirm that the official purchase route is active

facts.drivetrain: Custom build: Shimano Dura-Ace R9270 with 10-36 cassette
facts.frame_material: Generation conflict: the 2024 third-generation official frame uses UHMS-EPS+ carbon with T1100 and M40 reinforcement, while older official material reports a different approximately 750 g generation; the competition build is not mapped to either
facts.frame_construction: The 2024 third-generation platform uses full hidden routing and a dedicated fork/cockpit, but those details are not transferred to the unresolved competition build

source_note: The 6.2 kg XS competition build remains unmapped between incompatible official generations. Current official pages and retail indexes expose other Robin EVO configurations and fitted 28C tires, but no exact-build mainland price or manufacturer maximum tire clearance.
